events.title: Fall Antique Street Faire
events.venue: Ocean Avenue (E Street to Cayucos Drive)
events.summary: 100+ vendors fill Ocean Ave with antiques, collectibles & vintage finds. Free admission & parking. Food court at N. Ocean Ave & D St. 7am–3pm.

events.title: SLO County Open Studios Art Tour – Weekend 2
events.summary: Self-guided tour of 165+ open artist studios countywide, 10am–4pm both days. Free; some Cayucos-area artists participate. Also ran Oct 10–11.

events.title: 35th Annual Cayucos Car Show
events.summary: Classic cars line Ocean Ave 8am–4pm. Live band, beer garden & BBQ. Free to spectators, rain or shine. Friday check-in party at Nelson's Garage.

events.title: Christmas in Cayucos – Tree Lighting
events.venue: Corner of D Street & Ocean Avenue, Downtown Cayucos
events.organizer: Cayucos Chamber of Commerce, Cayucos Rotary & local merchants
events.summary: Free holiday tree lighting with live music, carolers, Santa & Mrs. Claus arriving by fire engine, hot refreshments. Kicks off the Christmas weekend.

events.title: Christmas in Cayucos – Wonderland Walk
events.organizer: Cayucos Chamber of Commerce, Cayucos Rotary & local merchants
events.summary: Free evening shopping stroll 4–7pm with horse-drawn carriage rides, kids' craft workshop, snowy play area, Santa visits & Lioness Club refreshments.
